risks.risk: Battery health is degraded or not as claimed
risks.proof: A screen-on photo showing battery percentage and health (via Settings > Battery > Battery Health) or a video of the phone in use for 10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with degraded battery

risks.risk: Storage capacity is not 128GB (could be 64GB or 256GB)
risks.proof: A screen photo showing Settings > General > About > Capacity or a video of the phone showing the storage info.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower storage model (e.g., 64GB) or unknown storage

risks.risk: Phone has hidden damage (screen cracks, water damage, software issues)
risks.proof: A video of the phone being turned on, showing full screen functionality, camera operation, and audio output. Also, a close-up of the screen for micro-cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or with unknown issues

risks.risk: Phone is not original or is a clone/replica
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the phone showing the serial number and model number (usually near the bottom or in Settings > General > About).
